subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should the agent runtime treat oversized, symlinked, or otherwise non-regular workspace `IDENTITY.md` files as missing identity when preventing unbounded reads?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and proof-backed, but it intentionally changes behavior for existing identity files that are too large or not regular files, and that compatibility policy needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the hard cap
options.body: Merge with the existing proof if maintainers accept silent fallback for oversized or non-regular identity files.

options.title: Require a diagnostic
options.body: Ask for a warning, doctor check, or UI-visible reason before merge so users can discover why identity stopped loading.

options.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
options.body: Request a bounded custom read path if symlinked identity files are considered a supported workspace setup.

recommendation.title: Accept the hard cap
recommendation.body: Merge with the existing proof if maintainers accept silent fallback for oversized or non-regular identity files.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history on the identity/avatar surface and is the best available owner for the compatibility policy choice.
